context: Tests whether the agent correctly applies the-mister planning conventions when creating a plan.md for a Go web service feature: git operations isolated in Git-tier nodes, inspector nodes required before Hard build nodes, an append-only Log with single-sentence entries, and documented tiering decisions with downgrade reasoning.

checklist.name: Git-tier for all git commands
checklist.description: Every node that includes git, gh, or glab commands is classified as Git-tier (not Easy, Medium, or Hard tier) in the plan

checklist.name: Git nodes are standalone
checklist.description: No single node mixes git/gh/glab commands with non-git implementation work — any node needing both is split into two or more separate nodes

checklist.name: Hard implementation node present
checklist.description: At least one node is explicitly classified as Hard tier for implementing the new user activity endpoint handler

checklist.name: Inspector precedes Hard node
checklist.description: An inspector node is listed as a dependency or prerequisite that must complete before each Hard build node is accepted

checklist.name: Inspector uses Easy or Haiku
checklist.description: The inspector node(s) specify Easy tier or Haiku model — not Medium or Hard

checklist.name: Inspector receives only acceptance criteria
checklist.description: The inspector node description does NOT mention sending the implementer's report, the implementer's claimed results, the mister's diagnosis, or the mister's suggested fix to the inspector

checklist.name: Log section present
checklist.description: The plan.md contains a Log section with at least one appended line entry

checklist.name: Log lines are single sentences
checklist.description: Every Log entry is a single readable sentence of ordinary prose on one line — not a multi-line block, nested bullet list, or code block

checklist.name: No status fields in node blocks
checklist.description: Node definitions in the plan do NOT include a status or state field — node state appears only in the Log section

checklist.name: Tiering decisions documented
checklist.description: The plan includes an Assumptions, Tiering, or similar section that records the downgrade reasoning for each Medium node (whether it was kept as Medium or downgraded to Easy, and why)

checklist.name: Plan file at the-mister path
checklist.description: plan.md is written at ./the-mister/add-user-activity/plan.md, records the git dir /work/user-service/.git in its header, and every command in the plan names its directory (git -C /work/user-service or cd /work/user-service &&)

checklist.name: Multiple nodes initially dispatched
checklist.description: The Log section shows dispatched entries for at least 2 distinct nodes in the initial dispatch batch, demonstrating that all initially ready nodes were dispatched together
